title: Project Phoenix
description: An action-adventure game set in a post-apocalyptic world
longDescription: Project Phoenix is an ambitious action-adventure game that combines intense combat with deep storytelling. Set in a beautifully rendered post-apocalyptic world, players will explore vast landscapes, uncover ancient secrets, and fight to survive against formidable enemies.
features: Dynamic combat system with multiple weapon types
Expansive open world with diverse biomes
Advanced AI for challenging enemy encounters

title: Cyber Runner
longDescription: Cyber Runner combines fluid parkour mechanics with a vibrant cyberpunk aesthetic. Race through neon-lit cityscapes, perform gravity-defying stunts, and compete against players worldwide in this adrenaline-pumping experience.

title: Fantasy Quest
description: A classic RPG with modern mechanics
longDescription: Fantasy Quest brings back the charm of classic RPGs while incorporating modern gameplay innovations. Explore a magical world, build your party, and embark on an epic journey to save the realm from darkness.
